title: fix(security): require patched Node and native pnpm runtimes

commit.messageHeadline: fix(runtime): require Node releases that reject compromised CA keys
fix(tooling): use pnpm that rejects compromised CA keys
fix(security): preserve qualified runtimes across main integration
test(runtime): align pinned Node fixtures and generated guidance
test(runtime): qualify service and update fixtures at patched Node floor
fix(security): update Alpine test trust and aligned workflow contracts
test: align guest runtime fixture and preserve mock exports
chore: resolve main conflicts in Node security remediation
fix(security): resolve runtime remediation conflicts with main
